projects.name: Tehran Ride-Demand Profitability Heatmap (Reverse-Engineered Data Pipeline)
projects.problem: Identify the most profitable inter-district trips in Tehran by estimating demand-price behavior across 22 districts.
projects.solution:
Built a Puppeteer-based reverse-engineering and data collection pipeline with a minimal Express.js backend and PostgreSQL integration
to compute and visualize profitable routes as heatmaps.

metrics: ~20-day long-run binary price fetching cycle to cover district-to-district combinations
impact.business_value: Established a framework for demand-aware route profitability analysis for ride-hailing strategy.

challenges: API calling performance bottleneck while collecting full area-to-area pricing data at scale
